metas.name: Alishan National Forest train
metas.note: A green train car can be found in east Chiayi around Alishan National Forest.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Areca palm plantations
metas.note: Areca palm plantations in Pingtung are mainly found in neat, organised rows like these, in the flat plains. While in most central and southern counties, they will be found in the mountainous areas. Additionally, the counties further north will also rarely have areca palms in the flat plains of the west coast.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Changhua - Lamp stickers
metas.note: Similar to the blue plaques found on utility poles, Taiwan also features stickers to ID the locations of lamps. These can be found on both lampposts and utility poles with lamps attached to them.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Chiayi City - Pole stickers
metas.note: These green square stickers are typically seen on every pole in Chiayi City.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Coconut palms
metas.note: Coconut palms are primarily found in the southern-half of the island, toward the coast.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Fish farms
metas.note: Cultivated fish farms are mostly found right next to the coast in the western counties.They are generally seen in the southern-half of the island, anywhere from Changhua to Pingtung, but predominantly found in the counties of Yunlin, Chiayi, Tainan, and Kaohsiung.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Green Island
metas.note: The islands east of Taitung, Green Island and Orchid Island, are distinct due to the more tropical climate, abundance of coconut palms, and lush cliffs. Additionally, it is common to find run-down, concrete pavement. Green Island frequently uses yellow outer lines. Additionally, Green Island is slightly more built-up.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Guishan Island
metas.note: This very distinctive trekker features an overcast and surexposed coverage. The main island can be seen on the west.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Hsinchu City - Lamp stickers
metas.note: Similar to the blue plaques found on utility poles, Taiwan also features stickers to ID the locations of lamps. These can be found on both lampposts and utility poles with lamps attached to them.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Hualien - Narrow grassy roads
metas.note: This open landscape with forests of short trees surrounding a narrow grassy road can be found in Hualien in the flat parts of Guangfu and Fenglin. This area can be distinguished due to it being commonly covered in Generation 2; however, you can find similar landscapes in Generation 3 and 4.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Hualien-Taitung Valley
metas.note: The Hualien-Taitung Valley is a thin and long valley located on the east coast of the island passing from Hualien City at the north to Taitung City at the south. It is very recognizable as it consists of flat gentle plains surrounded by densely-forested mountains to the east and west.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Kinmen - Houses
metas.note: You can find these small, traditional-looking houses in Kinmen.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Kinmen - Trees
metas.note: The island of Kinmen can be recognized by these trees with fuzzy leaves lining the road and red-tinged soil.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Matsu Islands
metas.note: Lienchiang County, also referred to as the Matsu Islands, is recognizable from the hilly landscape and frequent use of concrete roads. The coverage is often overcast or surexposed and only in GEN 3.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Matsu Islands - Pavement
metas.note: This pavement is typical of the Matsu Islands.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Northern Taïwan - Apartment blocks
metas.note: Old and disorganised housing units as well as tall dingy-looking apartment blocks are frequently seen in the urban areas of northern Taiwan.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Northern Taïwan - Distribution transformers
metas.note: Distribution transformers raised by a dark green holder are mostly found in New Taipei City and Keelung City.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Orchid Island
metas.note: The islands east of Taitung, Green Island and Orchid Island, are distinct due to the more tropical climate, abundance of coconut palms, and lush cliffs. Additionally, it is common to find run-down, concrete pavement. Green Island frequently uses yellow outer lines. Additionally, Green Island is slightly more built-up.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Penghu - Blue lines
metas.note: Blue outer lines are almost entirely exclusive to Penghu (rare in gen 4).
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Penghu - Houses
metas.note: White-tinged cream coloured houses are frequently seen in Penghu.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Penghu - Leafless bushes
metas.note: These leafless trees are most frequently seen in Penghu.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Penghu - Trees
metas.note: Norfolk island pines are extremely common in the county of Penghu, especially in tightly-packed rows next to roads.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Penghu scooters
metas.note: Apart the main island in Penghu county which features up to a GEN 4 coverage, many of the smaller islands around have been covered with various scooters in GEN 3. Some parts of the scooter are sometimes visible: rear-view mirrors, trunk or even the pilot. If not, the blur is clearly visible.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Provincial Highway 20
metas.note: The Provincial Highway 20, specifically the part that runs through Yushan National Park, features tall mountains covered with coniferous trees. The road also utilises these tube-like double guardrails.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Provincial Highway 8
metas.note:
The Provincial Highway 8 that runs from Taichung to Hualien is very recognizable, specifically in the Hualien part, due to the yellow guardrail that can be found all throughout the western half of the road in the county.

The eastern half of the road features these tall exposed-rock cliffs that tower over the road.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Southern Taïwan - Special post signs
metas.note: These bent sign and chevron holders with two black and yellow-striped stickers are only found in Pingtung, Kaohsiung, and Taitung.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Taipei City - Blue truck
metas.note: A blue pickup truck can be seen in a few of the riverside parks in Taipei City.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Taipingshan National Forest road
metas.note: The road that leads up to Taipingshan National Forest in Yilan features a guardrail with red legs (rare in GEN 4) surrounded by coniferous trees and huge mountains.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Taoyuan - Lamp stickers
metas.note: Similar to the blue plaques found on utility poles, Taiwan also features stickers to ID the locations of lamps. These can be found on both lampposts and utility poles with lamps attached to them.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Taoyuan - Red bricks
metas.note: Taoyuan features these red brick and sometimes red tile apartment buildings. They can also be commonly spotted in the greater Taipei area and rarely in other urban areas but are most common in Taoyuan.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Tea plantations
metas.note: Tea plantations are generally seen in mountainous areas all over Taiwan. You can find them commonly in Chiayi, Nantou, Hsinchu, and Miaoli.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Yilan - Villas
metas.note: In Yilan, you can find these rich multiple-story villas.They come in all types of designs and are often gated.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Yilan Plain
metas.note: The Yilan Plain is easily identifiable by the mountain ranges that are seen in the north, west, and south. Rice paddies are also extremely common as well as houses built right next to these fields.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.
